description: Three independent audio-enrollment-conditioned passes through pinned TD-SpeakerBeam, one for each physical A/B/C target. Inference uses no isolated test voices. Eight fixed evaluation regions per room; each region supplied with its three-voice count.

policy.condition: actual AliMeeting array-channel-0 solo-turn remix, 3 active separated targets; fixed prior per-speaker enrollment taken only from the early labeled nonoverlapping excerpts
policy.confirmation: R8005_M8007 t01–t08, different room/identities; incumbent and previous unrelated models already known, all direct target-extraction predictions previously unseen; optionally reserve t09–t12 for extra untouched donors
policy.extractor: espnet/Wangyou_Zhang_librimix_train_enh_tse_td_speakerbeam_raw, official 99epoch.pth, LibriMix two-person English training, native 8k; run three separate extractions conditioned on separate enrolled waveforms. Use the same encoder on mixture and target enrollment as training. For each enrollment take up to 6s of sequential 32ms blocks with RMS above max(-45 dBFS, 2% of that enrollment’s maximum RMS), skipping inserted silence. Explicit A/B/C output follows the corresponding enrollment WAV in every case.
policy.direct_arm: Three target-specific outputs directly; no isolated test stems, enrollment remapping, or clean reference passed to inference. Positive amplitude fit only for an auxiliary diagnostic.
hybrids: map_only: compute full 3x3 squared correlations of directly conditioned TSE and incumbent streams. Find best one-to-one assignment. Accept TSE-assisted mapping when average assigned squared correlation >=0.30, average best minus runner-up assignment score >=0.10 and each chosen squared correlation >=0.15. Else preserve original enrollment mapping. Existing audio untouched.

blend: first apply map_only, then average the direct target estimate and incumbent after polarity alignment on each stream with squared agreement >=0.25. Preserve incumbent waveform on unsupported streams.
policy.selection: Count joint 96+98 in development; tie break by fixed enrolled median quiet target fraction then median per-target fraction. Report direct conditioned architecture, chosen hybrid and incumbent. Do not recommend a method with severe individual regressions. Upstream checkpoint has only trained for two voices; performance on three is experimental.
